edit.description: the repo pin's `trees` takes `harness/` beside `src/`, under a second `it` carrying its own title

summary: The literal-symbol pin judges `src/` alone, so the package's other shipped tree spells 30 more literal spans against a surface nothing resolves them on

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: the literals of `src/` and of `harness/` are both judged against the package's surface, each tree's claim carried by a test titled for that tree
pins: no harness/ string literal names a function the package's surface does not hold
notes: Per note A-REFUSAL-NAMES-NO-FUNCTION-OFF-THE-PACKAGES-SURFACE. `trees` is already a request field (`tests/helpers/literalSymbols.ts`), so the change is the request plus a second `it` — the standing title names `src/`, and a title is the claim its body asserts. Measured this drain: `src/` scans 10 spans and resolves 10; with `harness/` it scans 40, resolves 40, finds nothing. `tests/` is no candidate — 281 findings, its literals naming internal helpers by design.
